source.title: WFC Leader Announcement (November 2023)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader and WCA Treasurer. Raymond Goslow will become the new Leader of the WCA Finance Committee (WFC) and the WCA Treasurer. Raymond was already working as a Senior Member of the WFC.

Raymond was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We extend our support and best wishes to Raymond as he takes on his new responsibilities.

There were 3 applications for the role. If you are interested in viewing Raymond’s successful candidacy document, it can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1awN1mv6r3YIVnWSXWYdNxeePcOGGyhGU/view?usp=drive_link).

translation.title: WCA 财务委员会负责人任命公告（2023 年 11 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Raymond Goslow 将担任 WCA 财务委员会（WFC）的新任负责人及 WCA 财务主管。Raymond 此前已在 WFC 担任高级成员。

依照 WCA 委员会与团队[动议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Raymond，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

我们支持 Raymond 承担新的职责，祝他工作顺利。

本次职位共收到 3 份申请。如想了解获选者 Raymond 的申请材料，可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1awN1mv6r3YIVnWSXWYdNxeePcOGGyhGU/view?usp=drive_link)查看。
